study.notes: STUDY: single centre prospective open label randomised two arm study (NCT01208012, Mainz) in type 2 diabetes well controlled on metformin (HbA1c below 7 percent, age 30 to 65): liraglutide added to metformin, 1.2 mg daily by week 6 and 1.8 mg daily by week 12 (dose_mg 1.8 at the 12 week row) vs metformin monotherapy continued; 44 randomised, 4 without post randomisation efficacy measurements excluded from the full analysis set (1 liraglutide, 3 metformin), 40 analysed (liraglutide 10 men plus 11 women equals 21, metformin 10 men plus 9 women equals 19, sums from the results text); 12 weeks, the eligibility minimum; Table 1 gives mean plus or minus SD per arm at baseline, 6 and 12 weeks (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; the asterisks and daggers are within arm and between arm tests without values, not used); vascular and endothelial markers were the stated endpoints (prespecified TRUE); pct_weight_change from the Table 1 means in the liraglutide arm, 93.2 to 89.7 kg, minus 3.5 kg equals minus 3.8 percent (metformin 96.9 to 96.7 kg, minus 0.2 percent; no contrast printed); unrestricted grant from Novo Nordisk, two authors Novo Nordisk employees (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall some_concerns

rows.notes: Table 1: fasting plasma glucose mmol/l at baseline and 12 weeks per arm (6 weeks 6.36 plus or minus 0.99 vs 7.55 plus or minus 1.05); marked p below 0.05 vs baseline and vs metformin
Table 1: HbA1c percent (mmol/mol in parentheses, 45 to 40 vs 46 to 45) at baseline and 12 weeks per arm; marked p below 0.05 vs baseline and vs metformin
Table 1: high sensitivity C-reactive protein mg/l at baseline and 12 weeks per arm (6 weeks 2.9 plus or minus 4.5 vs 2.4 plus or minus 1.7); no significant change in either arm
Table 1: systolic blood pressure mmHg at baseline and 12 weeks per arm
Table 1: diastolic blood pressure mmHg at baseline and 12 weeks per arm

json.design: single centre open label randomised two arm study, liraglutide added to metformin vs metformin monotherapy, well controlled type 2 diabetes, 44 randomised, 40 in the full analysis set (21 and 19), 12 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); five inventory markers with baseline and 12 week mean and SD per arm in Table 1 by the imputed change route; the vascular markers of the paper (ADMA, E-selectin, PAI-1, MCP-1, VCAM-1, intact proinsulin) are outside the inventory
other_markers: vascular cell adhesion molecule 1 (VCAM-1, not ICAM-1)

rob.justification: randomised without a described sequence or concealment (D1 some concerns); open label add on vs no add on (D2 some concerns); 4 of 44 without post randomisation measurements excluded, otherwise complete (D3 low); laboratory assays, blood pressure without blinding (D4 some concerns); registered with the marker set as the stated endpoints (D5 low)

doubts: 12 weeks is the eligibility minimum and the dose reached 1.8 mg only in the second 6 weeks
hsCRP rose numerically in the liraglutide arm (2.4 to 3.0 mg/l) with large SDs; entered as printed
the comparator is continued metformin without a placebo injection
